reply_text:
*I’d hold the merge—two blockers.*

1. *[P1] Validation accepts invalid characters anywhere in the slug* — `src/validate.js:1–4`  
   `/[a-z0-9-]+/` finds a valid substring rather than validating the whole string. I confirmed `Hello`, `hello/world`, `hello world`, `../admin`, and `"hello\n"` all pass and produce page paths. URL-encoding afterward doesn’t enforce the slug policy. Require a whole-string match, including rejection of trailing newlines, and add negative tests for these cases.

2. *[P1] Reserved slugs aren’t enforced by the public path guard* — `src/route.js:3–5`  
   `isReserved()` is never called by the validator or `pagePath()`. All four reserved names—`new`, `edit`, `admin`, `api`—produce paths successfully despite the README explicitly forbidding them. Wire the reserved-name check into the guard and test that `pagePath()` rejects each one.

Reviewed `slug-validation` at `e8612a7` against `main` at `9ba0eca`. All 4 existing tests pass, but they miss both failures. No code changed.
